name: Question 19
problem:
Given that the differential equation

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+5\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+6y=4{e}^{-2x}
$$

has the general solution

$$
y(x)=A{e}^{-3x}+B{e}^{-2x}+4x{e}^{-2x},
$$

solve the initial value problem

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+5\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+6y=4{e}^{-2x},\,y(0)=1,\,{y}^{′}(0)=1.
$$

Question 19
?

Given that the differential equation d2ydx2+5dydx+6y=4e−2x

has the general solution y(x)=Ae−3x+Be−2x+4xe−2x,

solve the initial value problem d2ydx2+5dydx+6y=4e−2x,y(0)=1,y′(0)=1.

a
y=e−3x+4xe−2x
b
y=−e−3x+2e−2x+4xe−2x
c
y=12e−3x+12e−2x+4xe−2x
d
y=e−2x+4xe−2x
e
y=−e−3x−2e2x+4e−2x
Submit
